title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck on Textured Metallic Background Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom with the Custom Trucker Bedding Set from Jeminise, designed specifically for truckers and trucking enthusiasts who love the road. This cozy, modern comforter set features a striking semi-truck graphic on a textured metallic background, bringing a stylish, contemporary look to your personal space. Fully customizable with a personal name input, this bedding set is crafted from soft, lightweight, and breathable polyester to ensure maximum comfort and durability for all seasons.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a custom text input option to easily personalize the bedding with your chosen name.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is super soft, lightweight, breathable, and eco-friendly.
  • Vibrant & Durable Colors: Advanced digital printing techniques ensure the colors remain vibrant and resist fading over time.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized to fit various bed setups, with options including US Twin, Full, Queen, and King.
  • Easy Care: Conveniently machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and simple to maintain without high heat.
  • Included Components: Comes as a complete set including 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter with optional matching pillowcases.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Color Metal Trucker
Pattern Cartoon
Style Modern
Theme Trucker
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization Name text input
